description: Capabilities for the Centinelo Phone main window - custom titlebar controls + tray-driven show/hide + the auto-updater's read-only check (updater:allow-check) and its post-install relaunch (process:allow-restart), PLUS every one of this app's own `generate_handler!` commands the main-window frontend actually invokes (js/app.js, js/console-panel.js, js/error-capture.js/error-reporting.js) - see src/acl_capabilities.rs's every_frontend_invoked_command_is_granted_on_main test, which derives that invoked set from the .js source itself on every `cargo test` run rather than trusting this list to stay in sync by hand. The inline receptionist console panel (console-panel.js, mounted INSIDE this window since 2.1.0 - see docs/console-inline-panel-decision.md) is why the sidecar_hold/resume/mute/*_transfer/blf_subscribe/blf_unsubscribe entries are here even though the always-on main UI doesn't call them itself. Everything NOT listed below is denied to this window by build.rs's AppManifest, whose command list is parsed straight out of src/lib.rs's generate_handler! block (see build.rs's commands_from_generate_handler) - most notably admin_lock, transcription_manual_stop, premium_info, premium_diagnostic, get_audio_settings, get_codec_settings, set_blf_enabled and the hid_* commands: all 11 are registered in generate_handler! but not invoked from any shipped frontend (the audio/codec/BLF panels paint from sidecar-pushed events, not from calling these - see src/acl_capabilities.rs's unused_commands_are_granted_nowhere test), and the whole admin/license/provisioning surface is intentionally scoped to just this window, never to `console` (see capabilities/console.json's description for why that split matters).
